recognize_zh: 脂肪空泡旁一顆組織球的細胞質內含多顆完整紅血球，並夾雜數個小而深染的圓形有核細胞（紅血球前驅細胞或淋巴球），同時吞噬紅血球與有核細胞，符合噬血現象。
features: Histiocyte containing multiple intact orange-red erythrocytes
Several engulfed small nucleated cells with dense, round nuclei among the ingested red cells
Histiocyte located adjacent to a large fat vacuole
Surrounding cellular marrow with erythroid precursors and larger cells with open chromatin
No granulomas or sheets of atypical cells in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a histiocyte containing numerous intact erythrocytes together with several small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei, likely erythroid precursors or lymphocytes. The histiocyte lies adjacent to a fat vacuole within cellular marrow containing erythroid precursors and larger mononuclear cells. No granulomas or overt lymphomatous infiltrate is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, including phagocytosis of nucleated cells, in the setting of acute EBV infection; formal HLH criteria should be applied.

ddx.vs: Erythroblastic islands show nucleated erythroid cells arranged around a macrophage rather than enclosed within its cytoplasm alongside ingested red cells.
Emperipolesis in Rosai-Dorfman involves intact lymphocytes within large S100+ histiocytes, typically in lymph node sinuses, without erythrophagocytosis.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and contain passing hematopoietic cells, not phagocytosed erythrocytes.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows sheets of cytologically atypical, pleomorphic histiocytes rather than scattered bland phagocytic histiocytes.
